w07-f1.note: Kickline Analytics model_v0, Week 7 run 1 (manual, run at 2026-10-23T15:46:07Z). Expected points = 0.1*(expKR*ypKR + expPR*ypPR) + 6*tdPct/100 exactly (tdPct = expected return TDs per game x100 = KR share-weighted TD hazard; pTD in table = simulated P(>=1 return TD)). Method: (1) team volume: Poisson GLM on 2018-2026 team-games, kickoffs received ~ opponent implied points (b=0.027/pt) and punts received ~ both implied points, using Week 7 spread/total lines; underdispersed counts simulated with binomial (kicks phi=0.52) and phi=0.79 for punts. (2) KR returned rate: 2026-to-date league rate (0.804, prior-season blend m=40) + empirical-Bayes kicker effect (method-of-moments tau^2, current season only, kicker effect does not carry across seasons) + game-context logit (|spread| coef -0.040, total 0.020). PR returned rate: pooled 0.430 + favourite effect. (3) Returner share: conditional-logit on candidates (depth chart rank, Blueberry KR1/KR2/PR, recency-weighted usage, prior-season usage, availability) fit on 2026 weeks 1-6 with ridge; Questionable players weighted by P(play) from practice status (Full .85, Limited .60, DNP .45); game-level share noise = Dirichlet (K=1.1, P=0.3, MLE). (4) Yards/return: season-to-date league mean (prior-season blend) + EB returner offset (K k=300, P k=60; between-returner spread is tiny in the new kickoff era: tau about 0.5 yd vs sigma 8.5) + EB kicker offset for KR (k=40). Yards-per-return shrinkage is therefore heavy by design. (5) TD hazard: KR 0.29% per return (2024-26 pooled, 2025-26 full weight; 13 TD in 3771), PR 0.90% (2018-26 pooled; 63 TD in 7367); no per-returner TD modifier (not identifiable). (6) 20000 joint simulations of all 14 games give quantiles, pTD and P(top15) (rank among all candidates league-wide). Carried: CHI and NE (Thursday game final: CHI 30, NE 24) keep as-of projections built with a Wed Oct 21 15:00Z cut; actual points appear in why. They are ranked by as-of expPts like everyone else. Backtest (as-of, expanding window; code backtest_v0.py / bt2025.py, results bt_summary.json; naive baseline = rank by trailing 3-week return points, which reproduces the ~6.2 hits / ~56% quoted for it): 2026 Weeks 2-6 player-game MAE 3.71 vs naive trailing-3-week baseline 3.97 (per-game trailing 4.13); top-15 hits 6.4 vs 6.2; captured share of best-15 points 64% vs 56%. Structural out-of-sample check on 2025 Weeks 4-18 (nothing tuned there): MAE 3.84 vs 4.30 (last-3 baseline), hits 6.27 vs 5.0, captured 60% vs 51%. 2026 hit differences are within noise (se about 0.5). Could NOT be replayed as-of: (a) Blueberry docs for describesWeek 2-5 have postedAt=null (posting time unverifiable; used as-is in the backtest), only describesWeek 6 (postedAt 2026-10-14) and 7 (postedAt 2026-10-22T11:10Z) are time-stamped; (b) backtest injuries are the final Friday nflverse report (Out/Doubtful/Questionable, ~4pm ET Friday), a few hours later than this 11am ET Friday run, which uses ESPN projected statuses; (c) lines are the nflverse stored lines (closing-type), not time-stamped; (d) game-day inactives and in-game injuries are not knowable in any week; (e) model-form choices (Blueberry feature, d3_nouse, game-context logit, kappa, prior pseudo-counts) were examined on the same 2026 W2-6 window, so that window is mildly optimistic; the 2025 run is the cleaner check. Zeros: q10 (and often q50) = 0.0 are genuine, most players have no return in more than 10% (or 50%) of simulated games; expKR/expPR near 0 flag players outside that role; ypKR/ypPR for those players is the league mean (no role data). Data gaps: no kick direction/hang time; ESPN Questionable statuses today are pre-Friday-report projections; ~5-10% of returns each week are by players outside the candidate set (spread into an 'other' bucket, not listed); LAR (new K McManus, no 2026 kickoffs) and MIA (K Patterson released) opponents use league-average kicker priors; Blueberry w06 alignment/kicker tables not used. No roster moves, projections only.

w07-f4.note: RUN 4 (scheduled Sunday final pre-kickoff run, model_v0 code unchanged). Changes since run 3: inputs re-pulled 2026-10-25T16:03:54Z: ESPN injuries now carry the game-day inactives for the 1 PM games (78 players flagged inactive), nflverse injuries now include the Friday practice report, newest depth snapshot 2026-10-25T12:30:46Z, pbp/lines/rosters re-downloaded; PIT-NO (kicked off 13:30Z) added to the carried teams. Candidates now Out (inactive or designated) with a role in the model: Anthony Gould IND, Olamide Zaccheaus ATL, Brashard Smith KC, Kene Nwangwu NYJ, Tom Kennedy DET, Brian Robinson Jr. ATL, KaVontae Turpin DAL, Tyler Badie DEN, Deebo Samuel SF, Jeremiyah Love ARI. Kickline Analytics model_v0, Week 7 run 4 (run at 2026-10-25T16:05:06Z). Expected points = 0.1*(expKR*ypKR + expPR*ypPR) + 6*tdPct/100 exactly (tdPct = expected return TDs per game x100 = KR share-weighted TD hazard; pTD in table = simulated P(>=1 return TD)). Method: (1) team volume: Poisson GLM on 2018-2026 team-games, kickoffs received ~ opponent implied points (b=0.027/pt) and punts received ~ both implied points, using Week 7 spread/total lines; underdispersed counts simulated with binomial (kicks phi=0.52) and phi=0.79 for punts. (2) KR returned rate: 2026-to-date league rate (0.804, prior-season blend m=40) + empirical-Bayes kicker effect (method-of-moments tau^2, current season only, kicker effect does not carry across seasons) + game-context logit (|spread| coef -0.040, total 0.020). PR returned rate: pooled 0.430 + favourite effect. (3) Returner share: conditional-logit on candidates (depth chart rank, Blueberry KR1/KR2/PR, recency-weighted usage, prior-season usage, availability) fit on 2026 weeks 1-6 with ridge; Questionable players weighted by P(play) from practice status (Full .85, Limited .60, DNP .45; Questionable with no practice detail = .45); game-level share noise = Dirichlet (K=1.1, P=0.3, MLE). (4) Yards/return: season-to-date league mean (prior-season blend) + EB returner offset (K k=300, P k=60; between-returner spread is tiny in the new kickoff era: tau about 0.5 yd vs sigma 8.5) + EB kicker offset for KR (k=40). Yards-per-return shrinkage is therefore heavy by design. (5) TD hazard: KR 0.29% per return (2024-26 pooled, 2025-26 full weight; 13 TD in 3771), PR 0.90% (2018-26 pooled; 63 TD in 7367); no per-returner TD modifier (not identifiable). (6) 20000 joint simulations of all 14 games give quantiles, pTD and P(top15) (rank among all candidates league-wide). Carried (carried:true): CHI and NE (Thursday game final: CHI 30, NE 24) and PIT and NO (kicked off Sun 13:30Z, in progress) keep their projections frozen at run f3 (rows copied from that run; carried players outside f3's 60-row table are dropped); because the simulation re-ran all 14 games with fresh inputs, P(top15) of non-carried players is computed against the fresh carried-team sims, so table pTop15 need not sum to exactly 15 after the freeze. Backtest (not re-run this run; code unchanged, figures from the corrected-code backtest in run 2; as-of, expanding window; naive baseline = rank by trailing 3-week return points): 2026 Weeks 2-6 player-game MAE 3.71 vs naive trailing-3-week baseline 3.97 (per-game trailing 4.13); top-15 hits 6.8 vs 6.2; captured share of best-15 points 66% vs 56%. Structural out-of-sample check on 2025 Weeks 4-18 (nothing tuned there): MAE 3.83 vs 4.30 (last-3 baseline), hits 6.00 vs 5.0, captured 59% vs 51%. 2026 hit differences are within noise (se about 0.5). Could NOT be replayed as-of: (a) Blueberry docs for describesWeek 2-5 have postedAt=null (posting time unverifiable; used as-is in the backtest), only describesWeek 6 (postedAt 2026-10-14) and 7 (postedAt 2026-10-22T11:10Z) are time-stamped; (b) backtest injuries are the final Friday nflverse report, this run uses ESPN statuses plus the nflverse Friday report; (c) lines are the nflverse stored lines (closing-type), not time-stamped; (d) game-day inactives and in-game injuries are not knowable in any week; (e) model-form choices (Blueberry feature, d3_nouse, game-context logit, kappa, prior pseudo-counts) were examined on the same 2026 W2-6 window, so that window is mildly optimistic; the 2025 run is the cleaner check. Zeros: q10 (and often q50) = 0.0 are genuine, most players have no return in more than 10% (or 50%) of simulated games; expKR/expPR near 0 flag players outside that role; ypKR/ypPR for those players is the league mean (no role data). Data gaps: no kick direction/hang time; game-day inactive lists were NOT available (ESPN core roster 'active' flags are all false pre-game; NFL.com not fetched), so Out/Doubtful/Questionable weights come from the final injury designations only; ~5-10% of returns each week are by players outside the candidate set (spread into an 'other' bucket, not listed); LAR (new K McManus, no 2026 kickoffs) and MIA (K Patterson released) opponents use league-average kicker priors; Blueberry w06 alignment/kicker tables not used. No roster moves, projections only.
